_meta.what_this_is: The retrieved candidate chunks for three queries, already scored and sized, plus a token budget smaller than the candidates. Each query needs two facts that live in different chunks. Two queries carry a near-duplicate of the top chunk (same fact, said twice); the third has no duplicate. The budget step must choose which chunks to inject.
_meta.results_are: A FIXTURE. Authored so a rank-order fill spends the budget on a duplicate and drops the chunk holding the second fact, while a dedup-then-cover selector keeps both. Point it at your own retrieved candidates.
_meta.budget: max tokens the context window allows for injected chunks
_meta.format: queries [{q, needs:[fact], chunks:[{id, score, text, facts:[fact]}]}]
